name: Astronomic Date
source:
A dating sim in a form of a collection of 12 short dates with female characters from [url=/p12841]Astronomic Games[/url]' previous games. Engage in dialogue and date activities with the ladies, win trust, turn up the heat, and if the date goes well, it can end with something really amazing.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款约会模拟游戏，集合了12次与 [url=/p12841]Astronomic Games[/url] 之前游戏中的女性角色的短暂约会。与女士们进行对话和约会活动，赢得信任，升温，如果约会进展顺利，就会有真正令人惊奇的事情结束。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290250/]Steam[/url]]
